general.descriptionTextModule: Maintain information bar messages per sales channel and language

info.description: Displays a time-controlled information bar with a customizable message and optional button in the storefront.

defaults.title: Defaults for new bars
defaults.stylingHint: These values are copied when a new bar is created. Existing bars are not affected.
defaults.timezoneHint: Start and end times of all bars are evaluated in this timezone. Unlike the other fields here, it takes effect immediately.
defaults.loadError: The defaults could not be loaded.
defaults.saveError: The defaults could not be saved.

detail.overlapWarning: Overlaps with "{name}" — the later starting bar wins there.
detail.invalidWindowWarning: With this time period the bar will never be shown, because the end date is not after the start date. Please check the start and end date.
detail.dstMissingHourWarning: On {date} the clocks move forward by one hour in the {timezone} timezone. That hour does not exist on this day — please check the time you entered.
detail.dstDuplicateHourWarning: On {date} the clocks move back by one hour in the {timezone} timezone. One hour exists twice on this day — please check the time you entered.
